name: Mobile AR Built-In Tracking Benchmark
description: Compares built-in tracking systems on popular mobile devices for indoor AR by measuring tracking accuracy, drift, and robustness in indoor scenarios.
evaluation_method: ATE (absolute trajectory error) / RPE (relative pose error) / tracking_accuracy
reputation: Used in mobile AR and SLAM research groups for device-level tracking comparisons, but not a single dominant community benchmark.
notes: Hardware- and OS-dependent results (device model, IMU/camera quality); reproducibility can be affected by platform updates; small-scale and non-LLM benchmark focused on vision/robotics metrics.
